subject: Approval needed: premium sign-on + equity refresh for Caleb Thompson
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request — Caleb Thompson (Principal, Inference)

Hi Rishi,

We need an out-of-band approval for Caleb Thompson — candidate for Principal, Inference (remote, US). Quick context: Caleb is a strong hire from Starling AI (lead LLM infra engineer), multiple competitive offers, asking for an elevated cash + equity refresh to match counteroffers and relocation flexibility (he will remain remote). Hiring manager (Anita) and I recommend the following one-time package:

- Base: $230,000 (within band)
- Sign-on (one-time): $120,000 cash (paid over first 60 days) — this is +$50k above the normal sign-on cap for the band
- Equity: 0.45% initial grant + 0.15% equity refresh (two-year refresh cliff) — refresh is outside the standard band refresh practice
- Relocation/remote stipend: $10k (one-time)

Why: Caleb brings deep real-time KV-cache and compilation experience specifically aligned to our serving runtime (relevant to latency work). Loss risk is high — he verbally confirmed a competing offer that presses both cash and accelerated refresh.

Attachments: caleb_offer_packet.pdf (includes manager note and comp comps), comp_market_snapshot_sept2026.xlsx.

Ask: Please approve the out-of-band sign-on + equity refresh so we can put the offer on the table today. If you prefer, we can reduce the cash to $90k and increase equity refresh to 0.2% — manager is flexible but wants speed.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Principal Recruiter, Talent Org
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0122
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request — Caleb Thompson (Principal, Inference)

Thanks for the summary. A couple of clarifying questions before I sign off:

1) Headcount: Is this within an approved HC slot for Q3 or Q4, or will we need an exception? (Karthik tagged as approver)
2) Comp benchmarking: What’s the 50/75/90th percentiles you used — please call out similar companies (e.g., LlamaWorks, HelixAI).
3) If we approve the cash at $120k, I want to understand downstream precedent — do we expect other managers to reference this? If yes, outline a short justification paragraph for the compensation committee.

If you can reply with the answers and the preferred fallback (cash vs equity), I’ll take this to the exec comp chair.

-Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Talent & People Ops
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Megan Li <megan.li@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request — Caleb Thompson (Principal, Inference)

Rishi — answers inline below. I also pasted the hiring manager note and market comps in the attached files.

1) Headcount: This fits an approved budgeted HC slot for Q4 (we're moving the start date to Oct 18 to align). Karthik: please confirm final allocation but manager confirmed internal approval to hire into the open Principal slot.

2) Benchmarking: 50/75/90th for Principal Inference (remote US) from our comp snapshot: L50 = $210k / L75 = $230k / L90 = $255k. Caleb’s total OTE with our proposed package sits near 82nd percentile vs. Prysm/Helix/LlamaWorks. See comp_market_snapshot_sept2026.xlsx, tab 'Principal Inference'.

3) Precedent: Manager justification paragraph (for exec comp):
- Caleb is uniquely qualified on production KV caching and compiler-level optimizations that directly map to latency SLO improvements we are prioritizing for Q1.
- His contributions buy down several months of infra roadmap work and reduce estimated infra spend vs. hiring two mid-principals (team-level ROI).
- Risk of loss is immediate — competitor referenced a $200k sign-on + refresh; delaying will likely lose candidate.

Fallback: Manager prefers to keep cash at $120k and reduce refresh to 0.12% if needed.

Attachments: caleb_offer_packet.pdf includes manager's ROI bullets and two recruiter references.

If Karthik confirms HC allocation, can we get a provisional approval from the comp chair (Hannah) to proceed?

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Principal Recruiter
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request — Caleb Thompson (Principal, Inference)

Thanks for the detail. I reviewed the packet and comp snapshot. Quick callouts:

- Cash sign-on: $120k is materially above the cap for the Principal band, but given the role impact and competitor pressure I can provisionally approve $100k without board-level review.
- Equity refresh: approving a 0.12% refresh with a 2-year cliff is acceptable as a one-off for this hire.
- To approve $120k cash we’d need an exec comp exception memo and a note from Rishi that this is a one-off (i.e., not to be used as a precedent).

Hannah — conditional approval: $100k cash + 0.12% refresh. If you want the $120k, I will escalate to comp chair with Rishi's memo.

Please confirm final preference (manager / Rishi) and Karthik to confirm HC allocation ASAP.

- Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Compensation & Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval needed: premium sign-on + equity refresh for Caleb Thompson

Ok — thanks everyone. Karthik confirmed the HC slot this morning (internal thread). Given the risk and the manager ROI case, I will authorize the full $120k sign-on as a one-time exception, with the following conditions:

- The exception is documented in an exec comp memo (I will draft) stating this is not precedent-setting and only applies to Caleb Thompson.
- Equity refresh approved at 0.12% with two-year cliff.
- Offer to include continued employment language for remote role and the $10k remote stipend.
- Recruiting to finalize offer packet and send to candidate by EOD tomorrow.

Marissa: proceed with $120k cash + 0.12% refresh. I will circulate the memo to exec comp chair and legal.

-Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Talent & People Ops
Redwood Inference
